fusions.name: Encrusting Graft
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Calved Colony
fusions.desc: Breaks off part of your own colony into a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, dealing 9 water damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave them [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Brood Reef
fusions.desc: Plants a reef that stands for 15 seconds and sends locusts at an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
